about: The AP Biology app pages. scripts/build-apbio.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in bio/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. Until that script exists the shell says the page arrives with the first published unit. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApBioCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/apbio-spec.md decision 2), so scripts live in bio/assets/pages/, not apps/.

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Biology practice by unit, topic or science practice: standalone questions and data-heavy stimulus sets, with an explanation for every option.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a science practice, with stimulus sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your biology spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Unit tests and practice exams
apps.desc: Timed biology unit tests and full practice exams in the hybrid format: 60 multiple-choice questions, then six free-response questions with rubrics.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams, scored with rubrics.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Biology free-response practice in all six question types, each with a point-by-point rubric, a full-credit sample answer and a printable answer sheet.
apps.card: All six free-response types, with rubrics and sample answers.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition biology flashcards built from the glossary, by unit and topic.

apps.title: Simulators and skills tools
apps.desc: Biology simulators and skills tools: enzymes, osmosis, the cell cycle, Hardy-Weinberg, chi-square, graph building and more, each followed by questions.
apps.card: Simulators, then the questions about what you saw.

apps.title: Your dashboard
apps.desc: Your biology mastery by unit, topic and science practice, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and science practice.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every biology lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For biology teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and sharing pages to Google Classroom, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.
